source_url.category_hint: Men's formal and casual wear. All promotions → Mens.

risks: Carousel rotates promotional content - multiple slides may need to be captured sequentially
Magezon page builder generates unique class IDs that change on each page load - used partial class matching for resilience
Responsive design hides different sections on mobile/tablet viewports - screenshot selectors target both desktop and mobile versions
Deep nesting of promotional elements requires careful selector specificity to avoid false positives
Email signup incentive ($20 off) appears in carousel rotation and may not always be visible on initial page load
edge_cases: Primary shirt promotion (3 for $119, 4 for $149) appears in multiple locations - deduplication recommended
Promotional text embedded in href attributes (e.g., 'block=header_three') - text content extraction preferred over attribute parsing
Some promotional sections use background images with overlaid text - screenshot extraction essential for visual accuracy
Owl Carousel may require waiting for slide transitions to complete before capturing all promotional variants
key_locations: Page header carousel: Shirts bundle deal (3 for $119, 4 for $149)
Mid-page sections: Category-specific promos (Gifts For Dad, Blue is the New Neutral)
Lower sections: Email signup incentive ($20 off)
